title: Donna salvata da leucemia: il supercomputer Watson risolve caso medico
note: Reputable Italian national daily. Fully fetched, clean Italian text covering exactly this case: at Tokyo, IBM Watson reanalysed a 60-year-old woman's acute myeloid leukaemia, compared her genetic data against 20 million cancer-research records in 10 minutes, reached a rarer leukaemia diagnosis and suggested an effective new treatment (quotes from doctors Arinobu Tojo and Satoru Miyano).
